heading.$description: Palette D plum, still clears large-text contrast on bg.page.

primary.$description: Palette D Accent principal, darkened for AA. 5.06:1 with text.onBrand (white).

primaryStrong.$description: Palette D Accent principal hover step. 6.82:1 with text.onBrand (white).

accent.$description: Same primitive as brand.primary — no separate decorative surface exists yet, and this role has no component consumer today.

link.$description: Palette D has no dedicated link hex — reuses Primary (plum). 13.20:1 on bg.page.

eyebrow.$description: Moved off magenta, which Palette D reserves for Accent secundario (badges/tags). 13.20:1 on bg.page.

ring.$description: Moved off magenta for the same reason as brand.eyebrow, and to avoid repeating the Phase 2 bug where brand.primary and focus.ring shared a value (an invisible ring on the primary button). 13.20:1 on bg.page, well above the 3:1 UI-indicator floor.

status.$description: Three distinct treatments per role, not one. Solid: <name> fill + text.onBrand (white). Soft: <name>Subtle fill + on<Name> text. Outline: on<Name> text + <name>Border border on bg.page. Badge implements exactly this. Palette D note: every base hue has moved (success now unified with the former Tertiary role, at 169°; info/warning/danger were nudged) but none of the four Subtle/on/Border trios were recomputed to match — pending recompute across the board.

onNeutral.$description: Foreground on neutralSubtle, or on the page for an outline badge. 4.65:1 on neutralSubtle.

neutralBorder.$description: Outline badge border — neutral. 3.03:1 on bg.page.

infoSubtle.$description: Soft badge fill — info. Pending Palette D recompute.
